core:fertility_count_until.note: A child with a town birth second counts as young until the first month start of its 18 whole years, alive or not; a birth with no person in the town never leaves.

core:fertility_extra.note: She starts an attempt only while her live births are below her wish plus this: one extra child in her life, by a new partner's wish or a grown child; twins may finish one over.

core:fertility_grown_from.note: A grown child reopens her only with at least this many live births (the smallest whole number above the target of 2.20).

core:fertility_grown_chance.source: ADR-0017, addendum of 2026-11-05: a play value, held in the refit of alpha
core:fertility_grown_chance.note: A grown child reopens her only if her draw FERTILITY_WISH at occasion 1 (her key, the seed of her wish) is below this; his slot does not read it.
